title: 第19章 内院考核第20章 抽签仪式
content_zh:
叶祈安走上天狮鹫尸体的身前，干净利落的将它一身坚硬的羽翼剥离。
这东西拿去学院卖，应该还能卖个几十元石。
“这点东西你们两个应该是看不上的吧?”
“叶兄喜欢就拿去吧。”
“没错，这一战如果没有叶兄的那最后一剑，恐怕还击败不了这畜生！”
为此为了拖住这畜生一点时间，苏也身上还出现了一些伤势。
毕竟是相当于人类的天元境修士。
如果不是他们这边有两个人掌握了入微的剑意，还真的拿不下。
两人回想起刚刚叶祈安的那最后一剑，要是让他们两个来接，恐怕也是同样的下场。
让绫轻烟不得不叹服，初见之时还是需要他来保护的淬体境二重，如今摇身一变反倒是需要他来保护了。
众人收拾好之后便离开了凶兽山脉。
回到苍澜学院中。
沈凝霜跟着叶祈安来到一家店铺售卖了这天狮鹫的羽翼获得了四十块下品元石。
路上，沈凝霜顿了顿说道：“你很缺元石？”
“缺！当然缺，修炼之人哪有不缺元石的？”
沈凝霜平静的说道：“修炼一途，前期元石或许对于你很重要，但是一旦你突破到了元丹境，你就明白元石的用处就不会很大了。”
跟这家伙说什么呢？反正她可没有元石给他，从中州出走之时，就没带上元石。
只因为元石之物在他眼里价值都是最低的。
对她根本起不了一点帮助。
外院来来往往的人流中，百分之百的男弟子皆是回头看向那一道白色面纱身影。

但同样的，无一例外看向叶祈安的眼神中都充满着羡慕，妒忌，甚至是杀人....
要是眼神能够杀人，此时的叶祈安恐怕已经死了无数回了。
隐约间他也听到了一些人的议论。
“这不是风头正盛的叶平安吗？”
“没错就是他，标志性的黑木厚重剑匣。”
“我可是听说朱烈如今已经伤势痊愈了，并且他亲哥放声要是进入了内门，便让叶平安死无葬身之地！”
“林霸天也是放出狠话，到了内门考核一定要让叶平安磕头认错！”
“......”
听后那些低声议论，叶祈安面无表情，手下败将而已，既然挡着他，解决掉便是。
不过那朱烈的大哥他也有所耳闻，内院强榜前十。
地元境后期。
这相当于一年前他的修为。
倒是有点挑战的意思。
训练广场上。
一天元境初期长老盯着下方众多弟子沉声说道：“各位，还有不到二十天的时间便是内门考核。”
“成功，则进入内院，失败则留学一年，其中利益的好坏，相信不用我说你们也清楚。”
“有些弟子表现出色，有非常大的希望进入内院。”
“林霸天，绫轻烟，苏也，朱烈，以及...叶平安，进入外院不久，便已经突破地元境。”
“在这里特别表扬一下叶平安，进入学院之时仅仅四重淬体境，现在已是地元境。”
“应当以他们为榜样，多多向他们虚心请教学习。”

“是！”众多弟子作揖回应。
场内有感叹声响起，同时也有嫉妒羡慕的声音。
content_en:
Ye Qian walked up to the body of the Celestial Griffin and neatly peeled off its hard wings.
If you take this thing to the academy and sell it, you should be able to get it for tens of yuan.
"You two probably don't like this thing, right?"
"Brother Ye, take it if you like it."
"That's right, if it hadn't been for Brother Ye's last sword in this battle, I probably wouldn't have been able to defeat this beast!"
For this reason, in order to delay this beast for a while, Su Ye also suffered some injuries.
After all, he is a Tianyuan realm monk equivalent to a human being.
If it weren't for the two people on their side who had mastered the subtle sword intent, they really wouldn't have been able to win.
The two of them recalled Ye Qian's last sword blow just now. If they were allowed to take it, they would probably end up with the same fate.
Ling Qingyan had to admire her. When she first met, she still needed him to protect her at the second level of the Body Tempering Realm. Now, after a sudden change, she needed his protection.
After everyone packed up, they left the Fierce Beast Mountain Range.
Return to Canglan Academy.
Shen Ningshuang followed Ye Qian'an to a shop and sold the wings of the sky griffon to obtain forty low-grade Yuan stones.
On the way, Shen Ningshuang paused and said, "Are you short of Yuan Stone?"
"It's missing! Of course it's missing. How can a cultivator not be short of Yuan Stone?"
Shen Ningshuang said calmly: "During your cultivation, Yuan Stone may be very important to you in the early stage, but once you break through to the Yuan Dan realm, you will understand that Yuan Stone will not be very useful."
What do you say to this guy? Anyway, she didn't have the Yuan Stone to give him. When she ran away from Zhongzhou, she didn't take the Yuan Stone with her.
Just because Yuan Stone has the lowest value in his eyes.
It didn't help her at all.
Among the people coming and going in the outer courtyard, 100% of the male disciples turned back to look at the white veiled figure.
But equally, without exception, the eyes looking at Ye Qian were full of envy, jealousy, and even murder...
If looks could kill, Ye Qian would probably have died countless times at this time.
He also vaguely heard some people talking.
"Isn't this Ye Ping'an who is in the spotlight?"
"That's right, it's him, the iconic thick black wood sword box."
"I heard that Zhu Lie has now recovered from his injuries, and his brother said that if he enters the inner door, he will let Ye Ping'an die without a burial place!"
"Lin Batian also said harsh words. When it comes to the inner sect examination, Ye Ping'an must kowtow and admit his mistakes!"
"..."
After hearing those low-pitched discussions, Ye Qian's face was expressionless. He was just a defeated general. Since he was blocking him, he just had to deal with it.
But he had also heard about Zhu Lie's eldest brother, who was ranked among the top ten in the inner court.
Late stage of Earth Yuan realm.
This is equivalent to his cultivation level a year ago.
It's quite a bit of a challenge.
In the training square.
The elder at the early stage of the Tianyuan Realm stared at the many disciples below and said in a deep voice: "Everyone, there are less than twenty days left for the inner sect examination."
"If you succeed, you will enter the inner courtyard. If you fail, you will study abroad for a year. I believe you know the benefits, good or bad, without me telling you."
"Some disciples have performed well and have great hope of entering the inner courtyard."
"Lin Batian, Ling Qingyan, Su Ye, Zhu Lie, and... Ye Ping'an have already broken through the Earth Element Realm not long after entering the outer courtyard."
"I would like to give special praise to Ye Pingan. When he entered the academy, he was only in the fourth level of body tempering, but now he is in the earth element level."
"We should follow their example and learn from them humbly."
"Yes!" Many disciples bowed in response.
There were sighs in the field, and there were also voices of envy and envy.
